areas.name: Creative economy
areas.reason: Coherent with cultural and creative-economy objective and a cultural-space component with viable indicator; relatively high impact potential but small resource share, no clear efficiency or innovation.

areas.name: Sustainable cities
areas.reason: High adherence through integrated urban requalification, active mobility and public space; most of the resources go to this component; high impact potential.

areas.name: Environment
areas.reason: Only tangential adherence via green areas and microclimate; indirect link to conservation, very low resource share, little relevant impact, no evidence of efficiency or innovation.

areas.name: Tourism
areas.reason: Adherent through tourism-attractiveness objective and visitation indicator with viable targets; only partial link and limited resources, so low impact; no efficiency or innovation evidence.

bonus.reason: Proponent did not state the programme is exclusively aimed at federal PPA priorities.
Proponent did not state the programme promotes regional integration.
